endorsements.name: Patrick Reidy
endorsements.label: Combating the Insider Threat at the FBI: Real World Lessons Learned
endorsements.description: What do T.S. Eliot, Puxatony Phil, eugenics, DLP, crowdsourcing, black swans, and narcissism have in common?  They are all key concepts for an effective insider threat program.  Come hear how the FBI uses a surprising variety of methods to combat insiders.  In this session the FBI will provide five key lessons learned about effective detection and deterrence techniques used in the FBI's insider threat program developed over the last decade.  The talk will provide insight on how our nation's premier law enforcement agency is detecting and deterring insider threat using a variety of techniques and technologies.  This session will provide unique lessons learned from building a real world, operational insider threat monitoring and response program.
